bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; designating the city of St. Peter as the honorary capital of Minnesota; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[1.133] HONORARY CAPITAL CITY. +]

[+The city of St. Peter is the honorary capital of the state of Minnesota. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; designating the city of St. Peter as the honorary capital of Minnesota; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[1.133] HONORARY CAPITAL CITY.

The city of St. Peter is the honorary capital of the state of Minnesota.
additions: The city of St. Peter is the honorary capital of the state of Minnesota.
